lean-challenge-snapshot.sh anchors its Goals extraction on ^-? ?\*\*Goals\*\*: , so a Goals header carrying a parenthetical before the colon (the shape the nearest precedent plan, archive/463's plan, uses) extracts an EMPTY identifier set and the cross-validation against the Challenge declarations becomes vacuous rather than failing loudly. Worked around here by writing a bare '**Goals**:' header with the parenthetical moved to a following line; verified the extractor now returns all seven identifiers. The precedent plan's own shape is silently unextractable.
